name: Online Mode Reported for 2027
summary: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy told Bloomberg in September that GTA 6's online mode launches in 2027, a year after the story game. Bloomberg's own feature on 14 October also says the online component is expected in 2027. Rockstar has not confirmed a date.

sources.title: Twitch CEO says GTA 6 multiplayer will launch in 2027
Inside the Making of Grand Theft Auto 6

name: GTA 6 on PC by March 2027
summary: GamesBeat, citing four unnamed industry sources, reports that the PC version will launch in the first three months of 2027, sooner than PC Gamer's own estimate of late 2027; Rockstar has not announced a PC version or commented on the report.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 rumored to be launching on PC sooner than anyone expected
GTA 6 Coming To PC By March 2027 Says Report
When might the GTA 6 PC release date be?

name: Pre-Orders Estimated at 7.7 Million
summary: Sensor Tower estimates 7.71 million pre-purchases, 74% of them on PS5, and up to 25 million by launch. Rockstar has not shared sales figures, but Take-Two says pre-orders are far above its forecast, and Sony and Microsoft say it is the most pre-ordered game ever on their stores.

sources.title: GTA 6 Has Sold Almost 8 Million Copies So Far, And PS5 Is Dominating The Split
GTA 6 Pre-Orders Are 148% More Than Any Other Game
GTA 6 Is The Most Pre-Ordered PlayStation and XBOX Game Ever

name: Reviews Reportedly Land 18 November
summary: Insider NateTheHate says review copies went out in late October and that reviews can go live on 18 November, the day before launch, and Insider Gaming reports that reviews land before 19 November. Rockstar has not announced a review date.

sources.title: GTA 6 Has Just Been Sent Out Early To Reviewers

name: Rockstar Patents Hint at Smarter NPCs
summary: Take-Two holds patents by Rockstar developers for NPC route planning on large road networks and for data-driven character movement, plus a pending one that fits animations to different body types. None names GTA 6. Press links them to it through the inventors and the examples.
